labels.S: the mark put on the sub's own face (sidebar, banner, logo, styling)
labels.F: the mark made into a flair members wear
labels.O: the mark taken beyond the sub (stickers, the next artwork of the show, the source game's icon)
labels.D: damage or an error in the mark kept as part of the emblem
labels.C: the image corrected or bettered before it was adopted
labels.I: the adoption shown carried out in the record
